specs.Other Special Features of the Product: Backlit, Ergonomic, Programmable Buttons, Wrist Rest

features: Dynamic Lighting for Immersive Gaming:The Rage K20 Keyboard features LED backlight with breathing effect, paired with the Clutch GT900’s 13 dynamic RGB modes and dedicated RGB control button.

Precision and Responsive Control: The Clutch GT900 Mouse offers pinpoint accuracy with a 7200 DPI sensor, while the Rage K20 Keyboard’s 19 anti-ghosting keys and multimedia keys ensure precise inputs and seamless multitasking during intense gameplay.

Ergonomic Comfort for Extended Play: The GT900’s contoured shape and the Rage K20’s detachable arm rest, paired with a volume control knob, provide ergonomic comfort and support for long gaming sessions without fatigue.

Durable, High-Quality Construction: Featuring the Rage K20’s robust metal body and the GT900’s high-quality build, both with 1.5m braided USB cables, this combo ensures enhanced durability, reduced tangling, and a sleek aesthetic.

Customizable and Versatile Design: The GT900’s 8 programmable buttons allow for tailored macros and hotkeys, complemented by the Rage K20’s multimedia keys and sturdy design, offering a personalized and reliable gaming experience.
